veranderings.rede: 'Dit maak dit' has two pronouns side by side; naming the disease makes clear what eases TB, and the protected wording after it stays intact.
After the modal 'moet' the verb goes to the end of the clause in standard Afrikaans: 'moet ... vir vars lug sorg'.
'Kort vir' copies English 'short for'; 'die afkorting vir' is the Afrikaans idiom and a known word at Grade 5, with the protected 'tuberkulose' unchanged.
